verdict.rationale: RingCentral claims official MCP servers and a way to connect RingCentral to LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude. That is a first-party route to operating the product through natural-language commands, but the evidence is only one-line marketing mentions with no detail on which operations can be driven. The AI Receptionist and Agentic Voice AI features serve callers and customer interactions, not operation of the product itself, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documentation of which actions (calls, SMS, settings, call handling) can be performed via natural language, any in-app natural-language command interface, and hands-on or independent corroboration that the MCP/LLM integration works.
